Elle assure le suivi des demandes et des incidents clients avec un haut niveau de transparence, de responsabilité et de posture de partenaire de confiance. Le rôle inclut une participation à un dispositif de support « Follow-the-Sun » couvrant l’Europe et l’Asie, ainsi qu’à des opérations planifiées en heures étendues au moins une fois par mois. La personne collabore étroitement avec une équipe de support de niveau 1 basée à l’international afin d’optimiser en continu la qualité de service. Elle est force de proposition sur des solutions innovantes, scalables et industrialisées visant à automatiser les tâches répétitives et à améliorer l’efficacité globale de l’équipe. Elle contribue activement aux initiatives d’automatisation à l’échelle de l’entreprise, en lien avec plusieurs feature teams, notamment via la conception et le développement d’API orientées automatisation des opérations IT. Les activités sont conduites dans le respect des bonnes pratiques ITIL (gestion des changements, des incidents et des demandes). La personne renforce et applique les pratiques agiles, avec Scrum comme cadre principal, et apporte une expertise technique et une vision architecturale lors de la conception et de la livraison des produits des feature teams. Elle intervient sur un environnement de grande envergure comprenant plus de 2 500 serveurs, en assurant leur stabilité, leur performance et leur évolution. Profil Recherché Compétences indispensables : Expertise avancée des systèmes Linux Server (RHEL), incluant l’administration, la gestion du cycle de vie, le durcissement et l’optimisation des performances Excellentes capacités de diagnostic et de résolution d’incidents aux niveaux noyau, processus, mémoire et I/O Expérience des outils de supervision et d’observabilité (Zabbix, Prometheus, contrôles de santé personnalisés) Solides compétences en développement et en scripting (Python, Bash, Ansible, Puppet) Maîtrise de l’automatisation en environnement de production, des intégrations API et des outils associés Connaissance de la gestion des volumes (LVM, multipathing) et de l’optimisation des systèmes de fichiers (XFS, ext4) Expertise Puppet incluant la conception modulaire, Hiera, la gestion des environnements et l’application de configurations à grande échelle Expérience des technologies cloud et des architectures hybrides (provisionnement, intégration) Maîtrise de Red Hat Identity Management (IdM), de l’intégration LDAP et des mécanismes d’authentification et d’autorisation Connaissance des infrastructures matérielles x86 (HP, Dell) : firmware, BIOS, RAID Très bonne compréhension des protocoles TCP/IP et des services associés (LDAP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, NFS), ainsi que de leurs interdépendances Expérience des solutions de sauvegarde d’entreprise (ex. NetBackup), des restaurations et de la préparation à la reprise après sinistre Connaissance des environnements SAN, Fibre Channel, NFS et des configurations multipath I/O Compréhension des mécanismes de haute disponibilité et de bascule Expérience de la gestion des correctifs, de la conformité et de la remédiation des vulnérabilités Solides compétences en analyse des causes racines (RCA) et en gestion des problèmes en production Contributions à des projets open source (revues de code, documentation, plateformes collaboratives) Capacité à travailler dans un contexte bilingue Compétences Appréciées Expérience avec Red Hat Satellite (content views, lifecycle environments, gestion des correctifs à grande échelle) Connaissance de la suite Elastic (Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash) pour la centralisation des logs Expérience des outils de Software Factory (Jenkins, pipelines CI/CD) et des pratiques de Continuous Delivery Connaissance d’OpenStack (compute, réseau, stockage, opérations) Responsibilities As part of an agile-organized team, the role contributes to Unix operational support and infrastructure projects. The position ensures end-to-end follow-up of client requests and incidents, with a strong focus on transparency, accountability, and trusted partnership. The role includes participation in a Follow-the-Sun support model covering Europe and Asia, as well as planned extended-hours operations at least once per month. Close collaboration with an offshore Level 1 support team is required to continuously improve service delivery. The individual actively proposes innovative, scalable, and industrialized solutions to automate repetitive tasks and improve overall team efficiency. They contribute to enterprise-wide automation initiatives across multiple feature teams, including API design and development to automate IT operations. Activities are conducted in alignment with ITIL practices, including Change, Incident, and Request Management. The role reinforces agile practices, with Scrum as the core framework, and provides technical expertise and architectural insight in the design and delivery of feature team products. The position supports a large-scale environment of more than 2,500 servers, ensuring stability, performance, and continuous improvement. Required Profile Mandatory skills: Advanced expertise in Linux Server Operating Systems (RHEL), including administration, lifecycle management, hardening, and performance tuning Strong troubleshooting capabilities at kernel, process, memory, and I/O levels Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Zabbix, Prometheus, custom health checks) Strong development and scripting skills (Python, Bash, Ansible, Puppet) Proven experience with production-grade automation, API integrations, and tooling Knowledge of volume management (LVM, multipathing) and filesystem tuning (XFS, ext4) Puppet expertise including modular design, Hiera, environment management, and large-scale configuration enforcement Experience with cloud-based and hybrid architectures, provisioning, and integration Proficiency with Red Hat Identity Management (IdM), LDAP integration, and authentication/authorization workflows Knowledge of enterprise x86 hardware (HP, Dell), including firmware, BIOS, and RAID Strong understanding of TCP/IP and related services (LDAP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, NFS) and complex dependency troubleshooting Experience with enterprise backup platforms (e.g., NetBackup), restore validation, and disaster recovery preparedness Knowledge of SAN, Fibre Channel storage, NFS, and multipath I/O configurations Understanding of high availability clustering and failover mechanisms Experience with patch management, compliance, and vulnerability remediation Strong skills in root cause analysis (RCA) and production problem management Contributions to open-source projects, including code reviews and documentation Ability to work in a bilingual environment Nice To Have Experience with Red Hat Satellite (content views, lifecycle environments, large-scale patch management) Knowledge of the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash) for centralized logging Experience with Software Factory tools (Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines) and Continuous Delivery practices Knowledge of OpenStack (compute, networking, storage, operations) Partenaire technologique de grandes entreprises depuis 1979, le Groupe SII est au cœur de l'économie de l'innovation, avec 16 000 employés, une présence internationale dans 20 pays et un chiffre d'affaires dépassant 1,621 milliard de dollars canadiens. SII Canada offre à ses clients une expertise technique de pointe dans les domaines du développement d'applications, du web et du mobile, de la cybersécurité et du cloud computing. Nous fournissons également des services d'ingénierie, notamment pour les systèmes embarqués dans divers secteurs industriels. Notre ambition est de faire progresser les systèmes d'information et de contribuer à la création des produits et services de demain pour nos clients. De plus, l'inclusion est au cœur de notre culture d'entreprise. SII Canada s'engage à offrir un environnement de travail équitable et respectueux qui favorise la diversité et l'égalité des chances

review_candidates.title: LEAD IT SPECIALIST - SR. IT SPECIALIST - Cloud Identity, PKI, and AI Specialist
review_candidates.description: Who We Are: Our team, the Cloud Services team within the Information Technology Center, is responsible for EntraID (formerly Azure)/M365 cloud services and Active Directory for the Enterprise. The team provides support and implementation services to the entire organization's IT infrastructure. Objectives of this Role: Manage and enhance internal Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), ADFS (Active Directory Federation Services), and Certificate Lifecycle Management (e.g. Keyfactor Command) to maintain secure, reliable access to enterprise resources. Design and implement secure identity and access patterns for Azure and AWS services, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Hub/Foundry, Azure Cognitive Services, and AWS Bedrock. Lead the design, configuration, and maintenance of Entra ID (Azure AD) app registrations, service principals, and RBAC models that provide controlled, auditable access to cloud and AI workloads. Collaborate across IT teams (Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, Help Desk) to resolve complex issues related to AD, Entra ID, ADFS, PKI, certificates, and cloud identity. Drive best practices for identity and access management, Azure and AWS infrastructure governance, and operational scalability across cloud and on-premises environments. Maintain strong change control discipline and keep supporting documentation up to date. Daily and Monthly Responsibilities: Manage and support internal PKI and certificate lifecycle processes, including: Administration of CAs, OCSP/CRL endpoints, and certificate trust chains. Configuration and operation of Keyfactor Command certificate discovery, issuance, renewal, and revocation. Support and maintain identity and federation services, including Active Directory (user and group management, roles, delegation), Entra ID app registrations, service principals, Conditional Access, RBAC, ADFS configuration and integration with internal and external applications. Collaborate with IT teams to resolve helpdesk tickets related to: AD and Entra ID authentication and authorization issues. ADFS sign-on/federation problems and claims troubleshooting. Certificate deployment, trust, and lifecycle problems impacting applications and services. Implement and maintain secure access for Azure and AWS AI platforms, including: App registrations and security group-based access controls for Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Hub/Foundry, and Azure Cognitive Services. IAM roles, policies, and network/security configuration for AWS service. Maintain documentation of identity architectures, PKI designs, AI enablement patterns, and change records for audits and future engineers, and research and propose improvements to identity, PKI, certificate lifecycle, and AI enablement, including automation and governance tooling. Requirements: Requires a Bachelors degree in Information Technology or related degree field with relevant experience. In lieu of a Bachelors degree, 10 years of professional level experience, a high school education or equivalent with related certifications will be considered. Related Microsoft certifications are preferred. 6 years: Hands-on experience managing enterprise identity platforms, including: Active Directory domain services. Entra ID (Azure AD) app registrations, service principals, and Conditional Access. ADFS design, configuration, and support. 3 years: Managing a PKI environment and certificate lifecycle, including: Internal CA infrastructure, OCSP/CRL, and certificate templates. Demonstrated experience designing and securing access for Azure and/or AWS solutions, including at least some of the following: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Hub/Foundry, Azure Cognitive Services. AWS Bedrock or similar AWS AI/ML services. Strong understanding of identity and access management best practices, including: Role-based access control (RBAC) in Azure and AWS. Least-privilege design, MFA, and Conditional Access. Governance and operational scalability in cloud environments. A valid/clear driver's license is required. Special Requirements: Applicant selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Applicant must be a U.S. citizen. Job Locations: San Antonio, Texas
